hierarchy.target_read: high-end oriental fantasy concept key art with breathing room and selective completion, not uniformly finished commercial character illustration

detail_budget.goal: selective detail concentration for high-end concept art rather than uniform completion
compiler_rules: Concentrate the highest detail at focal structures only.
Keep major body and costume masses readable at medium detail.
Render peripheral and distant areas selectively, with impressionistic or atmospheric omission.
Do not increase detail merely because empty space exists.

rules: Primary highlights must remain the strongest value concentration.
Secondary highlights support form but cannot equal primary brightness density.
Tertiary highlights are sparse and subordinate.
Do not make every gold edge or fabric rim luminous.
Keep monumental scale but lower local architectural resolution.
Use mist, silhouette layering and atmospheric separation instead of literal architectural description.
Do not place the strongest background contrast or hard edges directly behind the face.
Background should support the character, never form a second subject.
Use crisp edges only where they reinforce the focal hierarchy.
Allow soft and partially lost edges in wind-driven and atmospheric regions.
Let backlight erase selected contours naturally.
Do not sharpen every silhouette equally.

round_plan.prompt_strategy: concept-art hierarchy only: redistribute detail, brightness, background resolution and edge sharpness while locking style target, identity, face mode, motion, palette, costume architecture and composition energy

prompt_skeleton: Keep the approved oriental epic painterly style, black-white-gold-crimson palette, beauty-first/stylized-beauty face direction, full-body epic composition and large-scale motion unchanged.
Concentrate highest detail on face, crown, chest-neck focal area, waist core ornament and weapon core.
Keep main garment masses, primary sleeves and major hair volumes at medium detail.
Let hair tails, outer ribbons, distant architecture, mist, clouds, ground reflections and peripheral effects remain selectively resolved and more impressionistic.
Use the strongest highlights near the face/crown/upper torso/weapon core; keep secondary garment highlights lower and peripheral/background light subordinate.
Keep monumental background scale but lower architectural resolution and contrast around the face and upper-body focal zone.
Use crisp edges only at focal structures; soften or partially lose edges in hair tails, drifting cloth, haze and distant architecture.
Do not redesign identity, costume, palette, motion language or composition energy.
note: Use after style target direction is approved. This round reduces over-completion without weakening the cinematic style target.
